WITH order_avg AS (
    SELECT
        l_orderkey,
        AVG(l_extendedprice) AS order_avg_extendedprice
    FROM lineitem
    GROUP BY l_orderkey
)
SELECT
    l.l_orderkey,
    l.l_linenumber,
    l.l_extendedprice,
    order_avg.order_avg_extendedprice
FROM lineitem l
JOIN order_avg ON l.l_orderkey = order_avg.l_orderkey
WHERE
    l.l_shipmode = 'AIR'
    AND l.l_shipdate >= '1997-01-01'
    AND l.l_shipdate <= '1997-12-31'
    AND l.l_extendedprice > order_avg.order_avg_extendedprice
ORDER BY
    l.l_orderkey ASC,
    l.l_linenumber ASC
